text: Jane can implement a time management strategy by leveraging the quiet periods in her day, such as early mornings before the children wake up or late nights after they are asleep. She should set small, achievable goals, like writing for 15 minutes a day, to maintain consistency without feeling overwhelmed. Additionally, she can use audio recording apps to dictate story ideas during moments when she cannot write, such as while caring for her children or at work, allowing her to capture inspiration and transcribe it later when the house is quiet.
